title: Blackout Timeline
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Blackout Timeline — The Cut’s 72-hour Frequency Fracture, NPC glitching, atmospheric signs, Blue Beam fear peak, lockdown, EBS truth, and frequency-lock extraction.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Blackout Timeline is The Cut: a controlled 72-hour Frequency Fracture that severs parasitic narrative control, glitches NPC scaffolding, and clears the field for EBS truth and true solar-family crafts. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Blackout Timeline deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. When Light Grids activate, the original realm is revealed and Resonating Sols extract via frequency lock.

questions.question: What is the Blackout Timeline also called, and what duration does it cover?

options.label: A
options.text: The Loop — a permanent blackout with no end date and no path toward EBS truth broadcasts rather than the controlled 72-hour Cut that initiates parasitic-overlay collapse.
options.rationale: The Cut is a precise 72-hour window preparing the realm for EBS, not an endless blackout without truth delivery.

options.label: B
options.text: The Cut — a highly controlled surgical 72-hour period that initiates collapse of the third-density parasitic overlay.
options.rationale: The Blackout Timeline is also called The Cut: a controlled 72-hour window that starts the collapse of the third-density parasitic overlay.

options.label: C
options.text: The Bloom — a two-hour cable glitch used only to reboot banks while leaving the overlay fully intact.
options.rationale: The Blackout Timeline is a 72-hour Frequency Fracture collapsing the overlay, not a brief bank reboot glitch.

options.label: D
options.text: The Surge — an uncontrolled seven-day riot window that permanently restores full parasitic media control worldwide.
options.rationale: The event is The Cut for 72 hours of controlled fracture, not a seven-day riot restoring parasitic media control.

questions.hint: A surgical window that initiates collapse of the third-density parasitic overlay.

questions.question: Who engineers the communications blackout as catalyst for global awakening?

options.label: A
options.text: Only random cable technicians acting alone without Whitehat planning or galactic alliance coordination.
options.rationale: The blackout is a controlled Whitehat and galactic-alliance operation, not random uncoordinated technician error.

options.label: B
options.text: NPC background programs rewriting their own code without any multi-dimensional or human alliance oversight.
options.rationale: NPCs glitch under the fracture; Whitehats and galactic alliances engineer the blackout itself.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasitic elites alone, intending to permanently jam every high-vibration solar-family signal forever.
options.rationale: Whitehats orchestrate the controlled demolition; the fracture clears the field for solar families, not permanent parasitic jamming.

options.label: D
options.text: Whitehats and galactic alliances engineer this calculated Frequency Fracture as the catalyst for ultimate global awakening.
options.rationale: The blackout is engineered by Whitehats and galactic alliances as a Frequency Fracture catalyzing global awakening.

questions.hint: Allied human forces and galactic partnerships are named together.

questions.question: Beyond severed cables, what is the true energetic nature of the blackout?

options.label: A
options.text: A Frequency Fracture that makes the parasitic overlay wobble and crack while allowing true memory to sharpen.
options.rationale: The blackout’s true nature is a Frequency Fracture that cracks the parasitic overlay and sharpens true memory.

options.label: B
options.text: A voluntary media pause where every network keeps full narrative control without any glitching NPCs.
options.rationale: Cables are severed, NPCs glitch, and the overlay fractures; it is not a voluntary pause leaving narrative control intact.

options.label: C
options.text: A permanent increase in parasitic narrative strength so no Sol memory can ever sharpen again, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The Frequency Fracture dismantles false narratives and sharpens Sol memory; it does not strengthen parasitic control.

options.label: D
options.text: A simple software update that only restarts phones without any atmospheric or biological shift.
options.rationale: The event includes atmospheric pressure drop, frequency shift, and biological signs—not a mere phone software update.

questions.hint: A named fracture that makes the overlay wobble and true memory sharpen.

questions.question: What are NPCs in the Blackout Timeline context?

options.label: A
options.text: Non-player characters — background programs lacking true souls that hold the simulation together and glitch heavily during the blackout.
options.rationale: NPCs are background programs lacking true souls; they hold the simulation together and glitch erratically during the blackout.

options.label: B
options.text: Military Whitehat commanders who never glitch and solely run every supermarket during The Wave in any density, cycle, or historical configuration.
options.rationale: NPCs glitch and scramble for survival; Whitehats orchestrate the blackout rather than being defined as NPCs.

options.label: C
options.text: Only holographic Blue Beam fleets with no role in holding third-density simulation scaffolding and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: NPCs are background programs holding the simulation; Blue Beam is separate holographical fear technology.

options.label: D
options.text: Fully resonating Sols whose memory always stays sharp and who never exhibit erratic blackout behavior rather than soulless background programs that glitch and hold the simulation together.
options.rationale: NPCs lack true souls and glitch; Sols are resonating sparks whose memory sharpens as the blackout progresses.

questions.hint: Background programs that hold the simulation together and glitch during the event.

questions.question: What is a Sol within this transmission?

options.label: A
options.text: An elite parasite permanently immune to Frequency Fracture and EBS truth broadcasts instead of a true resonating soul whose memory sharpens through the blackout.
options.rationale: Sols awaken as the overlay cracks; they are not parasitic elites immune to the blackout and EBS.

options.label: B
options.text: A true resonating soul or spark of origin in a physical vessel whose memory sharpens as the blackout progresses.
options.rationale: A Sol is a true resonating soul or origin spark embedded in a vessel; memory sharpens as the blackout progresses.

options.label: C
options.text: A background program without a true soul that only glitches and never carries origin memory, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: That description fits NPCs; Sols are true resonating souls whose memory sharpens during the fracture.

options.label: D
options.text: A pure cable-severing machine with no consciousness and no connection to frequency lock extraction.
options.rationale: Sols are conscious resonating sparks; Resonating Sols are later extracted via frequency lock, not lifeless cable machines.

questions.hint: A true spark of origin whose memory changes as the blackout advances.

questions.question: What is Project Blue Beam in this blackout strategy?

options.label: A
options.text: A banking software patch that restores internet cables without any sky holograms or staged battles, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Blue Beam fills skies with holographical fleets and fake battles; it is not a cable-restore banking patch.

options.label: B
options.text: A genuine first-contact protocol that only shows true living crafts with no fear staging at all rather than holographical fear tech staging a fake alien invasion for attention.
options.rationale: Blue Beam stages fake invasion holograms; true living crafts of solar families break through later on their own frequency band.

options.label: C
options.text: An NPC grocery algorithm that only manages supermarket stock during Phase Two crowd surges rather than holographical fear tech staging a fake alien invasion for attention.
options.rationale: Blue Beam is sky-level holographical invasion staging, not a supermarket inventory program.

options.label: D
options.text: Holographical fear technology Whitehats use during the blackout to stage a fake alien invasion and force global attention.
options.rationale: Project Blue Beam is holographical fear tech used in the blackout timeline to stage a fake alien invasion and force attention.

questions.hint: Holographical fear tech used during the timeline to force global attention.

questions.question: Why is the communications blackout an engineered necessity?

options.label: A
options.text: To permanently hand every media channel back to parasitic elites with stronger narrative lock than before, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The blackout severs parasitic narrative control and clears the stage for EBS truth, not stronger elite spin.

options.label: B
options.text: To prevent any atmospheric pressure drop or frequency shift from ever occurring in the realm instead of severing parasites narrative control as an engineered necessity.
options.rationale: The blackout includes a sudden atmospheric pressure drop and profound frequency shift, not the prevention of those effects.

options.label: C
options.text: To sever the parasites’ narrative control over the human population so awakening can proceed without continuous media spin.
options.rationale: The blackout is engineered to sever parasites’ narrative control over the population as a necessity for awakening.

options.label: D
options.text: To keep Sols isolated from each other forever with no community pockets or later EBS delivery instead of severing parasites narrative control as an engineered necessity.
options.rationale: Sols are guided into small community pockets and later receive EBS truth; isolation is controlled, not permanent abandonment.

questions.hint: Focus on what must be severed from the parasites over the human population.

questions.question: How are cyber actions and cable cuts framed to the sleeping public?

options.label: A
options.text: Only weather satellites are rebooted with no cable cuts, cyber strikes, or manufactured fear loops and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: The plan uses deliberate cable severing, cyber strikes, and a final fear loop—not a quiet weather-satellite reboot.

options.label: B
options.text: Blame is placed only on Resonating Sols for cutting cables to block EBS and truth packages forever rather than cable cuts and cyber strikes with false geopolitical blame narratives.
options.rationale: False blame targets geopolitical actors to push sleepers into a fear loop; Sols are not the blamed enemy narrative.

options.label: C
options.text: Cables stay fully intact while only one country is praised as a hero with no panic narratives at all rather than cable cuts and cyber strikes with false geopolitical blame narratives.
options.rationale: Main cables go dark and panic-blame narratives flood NPC channels toward named geopolitical enemies.

options.label: D
options.text: Main cables are severed and cyber strikes simulate enemy actions, with false blame placed on actors such as Russia, China, Iran, and North Korea.
options.rationale: Cables are deliberately severed and cyber strikes simulate enemies; false blame is directed at Russia, China, Iran, and North Korea.

questions.hint: Enemy simulation and false geopolitical blame are both described.

questions.question: Beyond data loss, what physical-field change does the blackout produce?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent rise in atmospheric pressure that locks the parasitic overlay denser than ever before instead of atmospheric pressure drop and a field-clearing frequency shift.
options.rationale: Pressure drops and the field clears as the overlay fractures; it does not densify the parasitic overlay permanently.

options.label: B
options.text: Only ocean tides reverse for one minute with no effect on the energetic field or overlay, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Named field effects are atmospheric pressure drop and frequency clearing of the realm, not a one-minute tide reversal alone.

options.label: C
options.text: A sudden drop in atmospheric pressure and a profound frequency shift that permanently clears the energetic field of the realm.
options.rationale: The blackout is a pressure drop and frequency shift that permanently clears the realm’s energetic field—not mere data loss.

options.label: D
options.text: No atmospheric change at all—only a software error message on a few corporate servers, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The event includes atmospheric drop, frequency shift, and a palpable atmospheric pop when cables go dark.

questions.hint: Atmospheric pressure and the energetic field of the realm are both named.

questions.question: What defines Phase One: The Cut (Hours 0 – 12)?

options.label: A
options.text: EBS already runs full tribunals while every cable remains online and no panic narratives air.
options.rationale: EBS follows later after lockdown; Phase One is cable dark and panic-blame, not full tribunal broadcast yet.

options.label: B
options.text: Internet and communications go completely dark as main cables are severed.
options.rationale: Phase One (0–12 hours) darkens internet as cables are severed and floods channels with panic and blame narratives.

options.label: C
options.text: Project Blue Beam ends permanently in the first hour with no fear loop and no cable cuts.
options.rationale: Phase One centers cable cuts and fear-blame loops; Blue Beam peaks later in the broader staged theater.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Resonating Sols lose phones while NPC networks stay perfectly calm and fully online.
options.rationale: Communications go completely dark broadly; NPC channels are flooded with panic, not left calm and online.

questions.hint: Communications dark, cables, and panic-blame on NPC channels.

questions.question: What characterizes Phase Two: The Wave (Hours 12 – 36)?

options.label: A
options.text: Crowd surges hit supermarkets, banks, and fuel stations; NPCs glitch visibly while Resonating Sols avoid large crowds and stay in small community pockets.
options.rationale: Phase Two brings crowd surges and visible NPC glitching; Resonating Sols avoid panic zones and remain in small community pockets.

options.label: B
options.text: All military forces disappear completely and no NPCs show aggression or dazed quiet states instead of Phase Two crowd surges, NPC glitching, and Sols avoiding panic zones.
options.rationale: Military forces are visible nearby and NPCs lash out or become quiet and dazed during The Wave.

options.label: C
options.text: Internet returns to full strength with no survival scramble for food, fuel, or bank access instead of Phase Two crowd surges, NPC glitching, and Sols avoiding panic zones.
options.rationale: Phase Two is defined by survival scrambles at stores, banks, and fuel stations under dark communications.

options.label: D
options.text: Everyone is ordered into the largest stadium crowds while Sols must lead every panic zone personally, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: Sols are instructed to avoid large crowds and panic zones, not to gather in stadium-scale surges.

questions.hint: Crowd surges, NPC glitching, and guidance for Resonating Sols.

questions.question: How do military forces appear during Phase Two?

options.label: A
options.text: Only Resonating Sols wear uniforms and replace every NPC unit on every street corner globally.
options.rationale: Forces are mostly NPC-controlled and positioned nearby; Sols are told to stay in small community pockets.

options.label: B
options.text: No military presence exists at all until years after the 72-hour window fully ends.
options.rationale: Military is visible nearby in Phase Two and later enforces lockdown before EBS.

options.label: C
options.text: Military solely runs grocery restock algorithms with no street visibility during The Wave.
options.rationale: Military presence is visible nearby during crowd surges, not limited to invisible restock software.

options.label: D
options.text: Mostly NPC-controlled military forces will be visible but positioned nearby during the wave of crowd surges.
options.rationale: During Phase Two, military forces—mostly NPC-controlled—are visible but positioned nearby.

questions.hint: Visibility and positioning relative to the public are specified.

questions.question: What defines Phase Three: Opening Hour (Hours 36 – 72)?

options.label: A
options.text: Awakening cracks open as people heavily question reality; false-flag narratives fall while Sol memory sharpens and NPC code flickers.
options.rationale: Phase Three (36–72) brings heavy reality questioning, falling false flags, sharpened Sol memory, and flickering NPC code.

options.label: B
options.text: Phase Three only restocks fuel stations with no questioning of reality or frequency-fracture awareness, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Opening Hour is about awakening cracks and recognizing the frequency fracture, not mere fuel restocking.

options.label: C
options.text: False-flag narratives become permanently unchallengeable while Sol memory is fully erased for all time instead of Opening Hour reality questioning, falling false flags, and sharpening Sol memory.
options.rationale: False flags wobble and fall; Sol memory sharpens rather than being erased in Opening Hour.

options.label: D
options.text: All NPC code becomes flawless and no truth about the event as a frequency fracture ever leaks instead of Opening Hour reality questioning, falling false flags, and sharpening Sol memory.
options.rationale: Truth leaks that the event is a frequency fracture and NPC code flickers rather than perfecting itself.

questions.hint: Questioning reality, wobbling false flags, and memory versus NPC code.

questions.question: What is The Static Build-Up during The Cut?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent cure that ends all yawning, chest heaviness, and later atmospheric pop effects forever rather than Static Build-Up buzzing, electronic glitches, and strong animal reactions.
options.rationale: Static Build-Up is an early symptom cluster; Drop in Tone and Silence Before the Snap still follow.

options.label: B
options.text: Total silence in every skull with no electronic glitches and animals remaining completely unaffected rather than Static Build-Up buzzing, electronic glitches, and strong animal reactions.
options.rationale: Static Build-Up is buzzing, glitches, surges, and strong animal reactions—not total unaffected silence.

options.label: C
options.text: Only stock-market tickers freeze while phones, power grids, and animals show zero change, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point.
options.rationale: Phones freeze, power surges sweep the grid, and animals react strongly—not ticker-only symptoms.

options.label: D
options.text: Subtle skull buzzing like white noise, glitching electronics and freezes, power surges, and strong animal reactions such as erratic birds and restless dogs.
options.rationale: Static Build-Up includes skull buzzing, electronic glitches and freezes, power surges, and strong animal reactions.

questions.hint: Skull buzzing, electronics, and animal reactions are listed together.

questions.question: What is The Drop in Tone as a biological and environmental sign?

options.label: A
options.text: Unlimited energy for every sleeper with a brilliantly clear sky and perfectly calm NPC behavior, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The sign is tiredness, muted sky, and NPC outbursts—not unlimited energy and perfect NPC calm.

options.label: B
options.text: Sudden deep tiredness, unprovoked yawning, heavy chest, a muted flat sky, and unpredictable NPC emotional outbursts such as snapping or crying.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone includes deep tiredness, yawning, heavy chest, muted flat sky, and unexpected NPC emotional outbursts.

options.label: C
options.text: Only bank apps crash while bodies feel light and the parasite overlay appears more solid than ever instead of Drop in Tone tiredness, muted sky, and unexpected NPC outbursts.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone signals overlay glitching with bodily heaviness and muted sky, not a more solid overlay.

options.label: D
options.text: A legal decree banning yawning with no biological or sky-tone changes during the blackout instead of Drop in Tone tiredness, muted sky, and unexpected NPC outbursts.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone is lived biological and atmospheric experience, not a legal ban on yawning.

questions.hint: Tiredness, chest heaviness, muted sky, and NPC emotional outbursts.

questions.question: What marks The Sharp Edge during the blackout signs?

options.label: A
options.text: Long deep sleep for everyone with thinner air and constant continuous bird songs at peak volume.
options.rationale: Sharp Edge is adrenaline and thicker air with infrequent bird songs—not deep sleep and constant loud birds.

options.label: B
options.text: Only political speeches grow louder while hearts, air pressure feel, and birds remain unchanged.
options.rationale: Named markers are biological adrenaline, thicker air, and quieter bird song—not louder speeches alone.

options.label: C
options.text: A permanent end to all atmospheric pop effects before cables ever go dark rather than Sharp Edge adrenaline spikes, thicker air, and infrequent bird songs.
options.rationale: Sharp Edge is a mid-sign cluster; Silence Before the Snap and the atmospheric pop still occur when cables darken.

options.label: D
options.text: Short unprovoked adrenaline bursts, momentary heart-rate spikes, thicker storm-like air, and infrequent bird songs.
options.rationale: The Sharp Edge brings adrenaline bursts, heart-rate spikes, thicker pre-storm air, and infrequent bird songs.

questions.hint: Adrenaline, heart rate, air pressure feel, and bird song frequency.

questions.question: What happens in The Silence Before the Snap when cables go dark?

options.label: A
options.text: Ears ring at a high pitch, strange stillness falls, then a sudden atmospheric pressure drop creates a palpable pop and leaves the field clearer than ever.
options.rationale: Silence Before the Snap brings high-pitch ringing and stillness; cable dark produces a pressure pop that clears the field.

options.label: B
options.text: Noise doubles everywhere with no stillness, no ear ringing, and a denser more confused energetic field afterward instead of ringing stillness ending in an atmospheric pop that clears the field.
options.rationale: The sign is stillness and ringing ending in a clearing pop—not doubled noise and denser confusion.

options.label: C
options.text: Only traffic gets louder while wind and nature grow more chaotic with no atmospheric pop at all, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point.
options.rationale: Traffic noise fades, wind pauses, and nature holds its breath before the pressure pop.

options.label: D
options.text: Cables stay lit while a silent movie plays on every phone with no field-clearing effect instead of ringing stillness ending in an atmospheric pop that clears the field.
options.rationale: When cables actually go dark the pressure pop hits; the field becomes clearer, not a silent movie with live cables.

questions.hint: Ringing ears, stillness, then a pressure pop that clears the field.

questions.question: How does the Blackout Timeline connect to the Staged WW3 Event?

options.label: A
options.text: Only grocery logistics training with no war theater and no connection to fake alien invasion staging rather than Whitehat-controlled A.I. war theater with TV-choreographed strikes.
options.rationale: The blackout links to Staged WW3 and later Blue Beam fleets—not grocery training alone.

options.label: B
options.text: An A.I. war theater on autopilot but Whitehat-controlled uses surgical military strikes choreographed for television to convince the mass mind of extinction risk.
options.rationale: Staged WW3 runs as Whitehat-controlled A.I. war theater with TV-choreographed surgical strikes to sell extinction fear.

options.label: C
options.text: A spontaneous unscripted war with no Whitehat control, no television choreography, and no link to the blackout rather than Whitehat-controlled A.I. war theater with TV-choreographed strikes.
options.rationale: The theater is controlled by Whitehats and choreographed for television as part of the blackout-linked strategy.

options.label: D
options.text: A pure diplomatic conference with no military strikes and no mass-mind extinction narrative at all, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Surgical military strikes for television are used to convince the mass mind of facing extinction.

questions.hint: A.I. war theater, surgical strikes for television, and extinction narrative.

questions.question: How does Project Blue Beam peak within this staged fear sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: Blue Beam only prints newspapers with no sky holograms and no staged abduction narratives instead of holographical fleets staging fake galactic battles and abductions.
options.rationale: The peak is holographical fleets filling the skies, not newspaper-only messaging.

options.label: B
options.text: Blue Beam permanently cancels EBS so no tribunals or confessions can ever broadcast instead of holographical fleets staging fake galactic battles and abductions.
options.rationale: Blue Beam is fear staging before lockdown and EBS truth broadcasts, not the cancellation of EBS.

options.label: C
options.text: Only true solar-family crafts appear with full open disclosure and no fake battles or abductions staged.
options.rationale: Blue Beam stages fake fleets and battles; true living crafts break through later on their own frequency band.

options.label: D
options.text: Holographical fleets fill the skies staging fake galactic battles and abductions to shatter the collective completely.
options.rationale: Blue Beam peaks with holographical fleets staging fake galactic battles and abductions to shatter the collective.

questions.hint: Skies fill with holographical fleets and fake galactic events.

questions.question: After fear peaks during the blackout, what does the military enforce next?

options.label: A
options.text: A visible lockdown to maintain order, clearing the stage for the Emergency Broadcast System (EBS).
options.rationale: Once fear peaks, military enforces a visible lockdown to maintain order and clear the stage for EBS.

options.label: B
options.text: Immediate permanent internet restoration to parasitic media with no EBS and no lockdown.
options.rationale: Lockdown clears the stage for EBS takeover of channels, not restoration of parasitic media spin.

options.label: C
options.text: Only Blue Beam continues forever with no path to tribunals, confessions, or suppressed truths.
options.rationale: Blue Beam fear peaks, then lockdown and EBS deliver tribunals, confessions, and proof of elite crimes.

options.label: D
options.text: Total disbanding of all military units so no order maintenance occurs before truth airs.
options.rationale: Military enforces visible lockdown for order before EBS; it does not disband entirely first.

questions.hint: Order maintenance that clears the stage for a named broadcast system.

questions.question: What does the EBS do once it takes over public channels?

options.label: A
options.text: It severs remaining internet restrictions and broadcasts tribunals, confessions, and proof of election fraud, human trafficking, and elite corruption.
options.rationale: EBS severs remaining internet restrictions and airs tribunals, confessions, and proof of fraud, trafficking, and elite corruption.

options.label: B
options.text: It returns full narrative control to the same parasitic cable news networks without any truth content, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: EBS is military-controlled takeover to shatter false reality with suppressed truths, not parasitic spin restoration.

options.label: C
options.text: It solely reboots NPC supermarket code with no election fraud or trafficking disclosures instead of EBS tribunals, confessions, and proof of fraud, trafficking, and corruption.
options.rationale: EBS content includes election fraud, human trafficking, and elite corruption—not only NPC retail code.

options.label: D
options.text: It only replays sports and weather while sealing all tribunals and confessions from public view forever, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: EBS broadcasts suppressed truths including tribunals and confessions—not sports-only sealed archives.

questions.hint: Internet restrictions and the content categories of the truth broadcast.

questions.question: What is the overarching strategic purpose of the Blackout Timeline?

options.label: A
options.text: To keep every cable online so foreign narrative feeds continue uninterrupted through the whole window, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Cables are cut and the population is isolated from external feeds so truth can land cleanly.

options.label: B
options.text: To maximize external media spin so every EBS claim can be drowned out by parasitic networks forever rather than isolating the population so EBS truth cannot be media-spun.
options.rationale: The blackout isolates from manipulation so EBS cannot be spun—not to maximize parasitic spin.

options.label: C
options.text: To isolate the population from external manipulation in a controlled environment where the EBS truth broadcast cannot be ignored or spun by media.
options.rationale: Strategy isolates the population from external manipulation so EBS truth cannot be ignored or media-spun.

options.label: D
options.text: To cancel EBS entirely and leave only Blue Beam holograms as the final permanent reality story rather than isolating the population so EBS truth cannot be media-spun.
options.rationale: Blackout prepares for EBS truth after fear peaks; Blue Beam is not the permanent final story.

questions.hint: Isolation from manipulation so a truth broadcast cannot be ignored or spun.

questions.question: What does the 72-hour frequency fracture ensure about parasitic networks and solar families?

options.label: A
options.text: Parasitic networks gain permanent exclusive control to jam every solar-family signal indefinitely.
options.rationale: The fracture ends their ability to jam those signals; it does not grant permanent jamming power.

options.label: B
options.text: No signal environment changes occur and cable news remains the only frequency that matters, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: A profound frequency shift clears the field for solar-family signals beyond old cable news control.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasitic networks can no longer jam or distort the high-vibration signals of the incoming solar families.
options.rationale: The fracture ensures parasitic networks can no longer jam or distort high-vibration solar-family signals.

options.label: D
options.text: Solar families are permanently blocked while only NPC channels remain high-vibration carriers.
options.rationale: High-vibration solar-family signals get a clear path; NPCs glitch rather than become primary carriers.

questions.hint: Jamming high-vibration signals is the capability that is broken.

questions.question: What breaks through after the fake alien invasion collapses?

options.label: A
options.text: True living crafts of the Resonating Sols’ extraterrestrial families break through on their own frequency band.
options.rationale: As the fake invasion collapses, true living crafts of Resonating Sols’ ET families break through their own frequency band.

options.label: B
options.text: Only Blue Beam holograms remain forever with no true living crafts ever breaking through.
options.rationale: Fake Blue Beam collapses so true living crafts can break through—not permanent holograms alone.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasitic warships restore full third-density overlay denser than before the 72 hours began.
options.rationale: The strategy reveals the original realm and true crafts, not a denser restored parasitic overlay.

options.label: D
options.text: Only NPC drones delivery groceries with no extraterrestrial family crafts involved at all.
options.rationale: True living crafts of solar/ET families break through; the point is not NPC grocery drones.

questions.hint: True crafts of extraterrestrial family lines on their own frequency band.

questions.question: When true Light Grids activate after the blackout, what happens for Resonating Sols?

options.label: A
options.text: Extraction happens only through bank loans and physical airports with no frequency lock involved.
options.rationale: Extraction is via frequency lock as Light Grids activate—not bank loans or conventional airports alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Only cables restore parasitic news while Light Grids stay offline and no realm reveal occurs.
options.rationale: The blackout ensures Light Grid activation and original-realm reveal, not permanent parasitic-news-only outcome.

options.label: C
options.text: The original realm is revealed and Resonating Sols are successfully extracted via frequency lock.
options.rationale: When true Light Grids activate, the original realm is revealed and Resonating Sols are extracted via frequency lock.

options.label: D
options.text: Resonating Sols are permanently sealed inside denser NPC code with no extraction path at all.
options.rationale: Sols are extracted via frequency lock as the original realm is revealed—not sealed into denser NPC code.

questions.hint: Original realm revelation and a named extraction method.
